summary: Frontend UI audit of the new TestimonialsWidget across the 4 sales landings. 3/4 landings PASS 100% (Kabbale, Astrocartographie, Pack Karmique — widget visible at step 0 with correct names/ratings/trust-bar, positioned above the CTA, CTA click properly transitions to step 1 form, widget disappears on step 1, mobile 375px stacks in single column). 1/4 CRITICAL BUG on /compatibilite: the route does not exist in App.js so the modified Compatibilite.js is never rendered — the actual route /outils/compatibilite renders Compatibilite2.js which was not touched.

ui_bugs.issue: URL https://consultation-astro.preview.emergentagent.com/compatibilite falls through to the 404 catch-all — no route matches. Main agent modified /app/frontend/src/pages/Compatibilite.js and added TestimonialsWidget with prefix 'compat-testimonial', but App.js only imports Compatibilite (unused) and routes /outils/compatibilite to Compatibilite2.js (which does NOT contain the widget). Result: no testimonials visible on any compatibilité screen the user can actually reach. Widget testids compat-testimonial-widget / compat-testimonial-card-0/1/2 are not in the live DOM.

action_items: Fix routing for Compatibilite testimonials: EITHER add <Route path="/compatibilite" element={<Compatibilite />} /> in /app/frontend/src/App.js (currently only /outils/compatibilite exists and it points to Compatibilite2), OR port the {!result && <TestimonialsWidget ... testIdPrefix="compat-testimonial" />} block into /app/frontend/src/pages/Compatibilite2.js (recommended, since that is the file already reachable via /outils/compatibilite). Re-verify by opening the reachable URL and checking compat-testimonial-widget + card-0/1/2 with Julie & Thomas / Amélie C. / Inès L., and confirming the widget disappears once result is set.
critical_code_review_comments: Dead code / route mismatch: /app/frontend/src/pages/Compatibilite.js is imported in App.js line 29 but never wired to a <Route>. The actual reachable page is Compatibilite2.js at /outils/compatibilite. This caused the Gary-Vee testimonial edit to have zero visible impact for the /compatibilite tool.
TestimonialsWidget correctly exposes data-testids for widget, cards, ratings, names, meta, quotes, trust-bar — good testability.
Widget correctly hidden when step !== 0 on landings and when !result on Compatibilite (once wired to a real route).
Mobile grid uses grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 — validated on real 375px viewport, cards stack in a single column with matching left offset (x=20) on all three landings.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (3/4 landings fully working; /compatibilite widget not reachable due to routing bug)

test_credentials: Not used — only Kabbale/Astrocarto/Pack-Karmique were testable at step 0 without login; Compatibilite issue is a routing bug that no login can bypass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Once main agent fixes the Compatibilite routing (either add /compatibilite route or move TestimonialsWidget into Compatibilite2.js), retest ONLY the /compatibilite (or /outils/compatibilite) URL: verify compat-testimonial-widget present with 3 cards (Julie & Thomas, Amélie C., Inès L.), 5 stars each, positioned above relation-tabs. Then trigger btn-analyze with valid partner data and confirm the widget disappears once state.result is set (i.e., when result-card testid appears). The other 3 landings (Kabbale, Astrocartographie, Pack Karmique) have already been fully validated at 1920px and 375px — no need to retest unless the widget component is refactored.
rca of the issue: RCA: The main agent edited /app/frontend/src/pages/Compatibilite.js (adding TestimonialsWidget + TESTIMONIALS_COMPATIBILITE conditionally on !result at line 193-200), but this component is not routed. App.js:29 imports `Compatibilite` but no <Route path=...> references it. The URL /compatibilite falls through the routing chain (no path='/compatibilite' anywhere) and renders a blank/notfound. The active tool is Compatibilite2.js at /outils/compatibilite, which does not import TestimonialsWidget. Reproduction: navigate to https://consultation-astro.preview.emergentagent.com/compatibilite → data-testid='compatibilite-page' is absent, data-testid='compat-testimonial-widget' is absent, body text only shows header/nav (no page content). Mitigation: either add `<Route path="/compatibilite" element={<Compatibilite />} />` inside the fragment under path='*' in App.js, or (cleaner) add the widget block to Compatibilite2.js which is the live tool. Recommended: patch Compatibilite2.js so the fix reaches users on the canonical /outils/compatibilite URL that is linked from the rest of the app.
